topic: Why the ‘mirror neuron’ myth overstates empathy detection

script.title: Mirror neurons don’t actually make you empathetic – the real reason
script.hook: Why does your brain think it feels others?

scenes.text: Why does your brain think it feels others?
Scientists once called mirror neurons the empathy switch.
Later scans showed they fire for any observed action.
That includes watching a robot lift a box.
So they don’t distinguish feeling you from feeling them.
Recent reviews find the link unclear.
Your brain predicts, then fills in the gaps.
Your brain predicts, then fills in the gaps.
That’s why you can feel moved by a movie.
Now you know the real reason:
